### How to Set Up ChatGPT MD

1. **Open Community Plugins** : Go to **Settings** → **Community Plugins** in Obsidian and make sure community plugins are enabled.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXX_j_5NhTFP0xgvellr5tw2tK2Vb8v2YRxQR-Cy2-ilWA-GCK_BrWgDgscWJbz9qPo_SHVQrLrK5P7Z3rKEl1Od5zEG9Hxkb02BpFt5kJjsQsjTuRtS5RwEPvRvwOdh-JrAv0n)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXByKIMaEZFqjiAlgTF79v3NAXF60Rz_yFW1KIxS8sgvbmZDRQJFtOwFCqR7_uKDxm1ID2ltxhPgI7utg-8GRUgfz1nxAQOYq2ehesa80GGMbgTebsxTLf8fQA8ns0Ac5uOThIxNeghPg)
2. **Install the Plugin** : Click **Browse** , search for `ChatGPT MD` , and click **Install** then **Enable**.
3. **Add Your API Key** : Get an API key from your AI provider (such as OpenAI). Go to **Settings** → **ChatGPT MD** and paste your API key into the configuration field.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXZofjiJg5GgyWr-0Hj7395Dk2bV0AQqE3xAoBSfs8anEjHlVn0sAIp4g7EfdeQvqr6JixxtmhJqViwo4HD9S1TyvzWCA1BLtJ1pEz983ww823pmz8Iq3a8cY7WlCAM2TZnmM1z-ukP5g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXX_j_5NhTFP0xgvellr5tw2tK2Vb8v2YRxQR-Cy2-ilWA-GCK_BrWgDgscWJbz9qPo_SHVQrLrK5P7Z3rKEl1Od5zEG9Hxkb02BpFt5kJjsQsjTuRtS5RwEPvRvwOdh-JrAv0n)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXByKIMaEZFqjiAlgTF79v3NAXF60Rz_yFW1KIxS8sgvbmZDRQJFtOwFCqR7_uKDxm1ID2ltxhPgI7utg-8GRUgfz1nxAQOYq2ehesa80GGMbgTebsxTLf8fQA8ns0Ac5uOThIxNeghPg)
